items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: So I'd say about five years I've been with Thomas.

ctx.x: You've been with him ever since?
Ever since. I started with him just before I went in the post office. I'll be in there now six years. September. So I'd say about five years I've been with Thomas. Just about five. Yeah.
Yeah. And does it compare with, how does it compare with the other bands you play with such as, you know, like Buddy Petit or Kid Renee or Chris Kelly?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: See, now I got uh, Nelson. Yeah. Got Nelson to play with us, you know, with me, with me

ctx.x: Yeah that's right. And I'll tell you, in all the second trumpet I had, him and Russ in love was the best two second trumpet I had. He really knows how to play second you know. Well, and uh, so uh, then that was I got uh, that boy, what that boy's name again, this fellow, he's sick now, he's in the record band, played second. Oh yeah. Rodney. Well Rodney played in the Edmund Washington place, you see, after we was working for the railroad. He, well he played with us a long time. So then after that, well, I got…
Who was your favorite second coronet that you ever played with? Well the. When you had two coronets, did you play the lead usually and the other fellow played? Yeah, I played the lead.
All right, we're rolling. What's your name?
I see. And where were you born?
